title: Lesser Oil of Sharpness Recipe
summary: Records the recipe for Diluted Oil of Sharpness.

fields.Recipe: Mix Salts of Viridian Crystal with any Vitriol. The resulting single-use coating grants +1 weapon enchantment for 10 turns when applied as a Bonus Action. It cannot be thrown as an area coating.
fields.Availability: The source gives no acquisition location for this specific recipe book.
fields.Base value: 14 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
